log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill ONLY criminals reported in national, forum or foreign, about 5 a day. Use quick entries, always in the afternoon block. Afternoon kills only rule out day workers, so the pool is about 55,000 from routine alone. Forum and foreign traces cut it by at most 16x, leaving about 3,400, which is safe. NEVER kill regional:North, wire or cable criminals: one more trait like that drops the pool to 1,000 or below and I am caught. Getting the double multiplier needs 6 kills a day, which is not reachable safely with only 5 safe criminals a day. Check the press conference pool; if it is ever 5,000 or under, stay strictly national-only. Day 1: killed d1-2, d1-4, d1-5, d1-6 and d1-10 in the afternoon.
